hook.say: Islands only! Well, almost. Which one is bigger? Five duels, three seconds each. Number five is a monster.

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: UK or Madagascar?
questions.say: Which is bigger: the U K or Madagascar?
questions.fact: Madagascar is about 2.4 times the size of the United Kingdom.
questions.sayAnswer: Madagascar! It is about two point four times the size of the United Kingdom.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Japan or New Zealand?
questions.fact: Japan is about 40% bigger than New Zealand.
questions.sayAnswer: Japan! It is about forty percent bigger than New Zealand.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Ireland or Iceland?
questions.fact: Iceland is almost 50% bigger than the Republic of Ireland.
questions.sayAnswer: Iceland! It is almost fifty percent bigger than the Republic of Ireland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Cuba or Iceland?
questions.fact: Cuba is about 7% bigger than Iceland.
questions.sayAnswer: Cuba! It is about seven percent bigger than Iceland.

questions.q: Which is bigger: California or Papua New Guinea?
questions.fact: Papua New Guinea is about 9% bigger than California.
questions.sayAnswer: Papua New Guinea! It is about nine percent bigger than California.
